channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block K
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block K (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block K: The sentence 'The shortest residential tower would be on Block K facing Mission Rock Park and Pier 48' appears in the developer's March 2012 proposal (one of its likely scenarios) but not in the 2018 Design Controls. The 2019 swap of Parcel K for Parcel F is sourced to the developer's July 2019 overview and the Port's September 2019 memo. The Board of Supervisors' own records date the Mission Rock DDA approval (Resolution 42-18) to February 13, 2018 and the final passage of the Development Agreement ordinance (No. 33-18) to February 27, 2018; the Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the City's approval date and lists the Board's EIR action (File 171286) among its final actions. The Port's fact sheet lists August 15, 2018 as the Development Agreement's effective date, and the Planning page dates the DDA 8/15/2018. The Port's January 2018 staff report describes the DDA's outside dates for starting later phases (a legal deadline, not a forecast); the DDA text itself has not been read, so no calendar date is given. The Port's June 2026 report schedules the Developer's Phase 2 Submittal for Winter/Spring 2027 and a possible construction start for Summer/Fall 2027 (expected dates); no source read reports construction or a vertical design submittal for this block or states its current use. DDA-specific section numbers and target dates previously listed here are removed because the DDA text has not been read.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block K: Block K's page now says its edges follow DataSF lot lines, one of which (the Exposition Street lot 8719A010) carries a recorded drop date of March 18, 2025 in the Assessor data while still flagged active. It also no longer says the site is a surface parking lot: the Port's June 2026 memo uses that phrase for the whole project site, and says only that Phase 2 could begin construction as early as 2027. The page also now says which Phase 1 lot-to-building pairings have a source: Verde (8719C001, 1070 Bridgeview Way) does; the Visa building (8719A008), The Canyon and Building B rest on position and area.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block K: Block K's record and map shape now say: the Design Controls give Block K as 139 x 144 ft (not exactly the 139 x 143 ft lobe); the 120 ft height is tied for lowest residential height with Flex Blocks H, I and J; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the unconfirmed satellite-imagery statement is flagged; the shape's notes no longer call the block 'D4D-adopted'; the phase-status fact no longer implies Block K is in Phase 2 and includes the June 2026 Resolution 26-34; the Sept 2019 approval is described as Port staff finding the boundary change met the DDA criteria; the Jan 30, 2018, Oct 10, 2023 and March 11, 2025 Port Commission actions cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block K: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block K: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the date the City 'decided to carry out or approve the project' and lists the Board of Supervisors' final actions, including File No. 171286 (affirming the Planning Department's certification of the Final EIR) and File No. 180092 (the DDA); it was filed March 9, 2018. The Board's own records date two of the other approvals earlier: Resolution 42-18 (the DDA, File 180092) was adopted February 13, 2018, and Ordinance 33-18 (the Development Agreement, File 171313) was finally passed February 27, 2018. The Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance; the Board's file shows an ordinance (Mar 6, 2018)
item.description: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the date the City 'decided to carry out or approve the project' and lists the Board of Supervisors' final actions, including File No. 171286 (affirming the Planning Department's certification of the Final EIR) and File No. 180092 (the DDA); it was filed March 9, 2018. The Board's own records date two of the other approvals earlier: Resolution 42-18 (the DDA, File 180092) was adopted February 13, 2018, and Ordinance 33-18 (the Development Agreement, File 171313) was finally passed February 27, 2018. The Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance; the Board's file shows an ordinance (Mar 6, 2018). Source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-13; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-27.
